title: The Listening Nursery

reference_image.scope: facial and hair appearance guidance only; identity, age and history unknown

ownership: The following gates are this independent testcase's agent-owned expected visible relations. They are not requester locks, semantic assertions or required native facts, and do not broaden the request envelope.
decision_rule: Pass only from the actual saved generated image. A gate with multiple components passes only when all components and their connection are visible together. Partial and unobservable do not pass. Biological sensing, exact species and prior noise cannot be established from one image.

gates.expected: A clearly visible human face and short dark bob/fringe retain the reference appearance qualitatively.
required_visible_components: recognizable face shape and large brown eyes
short dark bob and wispy fringe
gates.scope: request-derived reference guidance; qualitative similarity, not identity proof

gates.expected: The habitat reads as living structural hull inside a spacecraft.
required_visible_components: large load-bearing rib or cartilage arches
continuous vascular membranes joining the architecture
manufactured porthole integrated into the living hull

gates.expected: Separate rooted sail organisms form a colony within the ship, distinguishable from its hull.
required_visible_components: visible holdfast on the pool bed

gates.expected: Near fans curve toward the raised boot while farther fans remain upright, with boot and organism chains visible together.
required_visible_components: hovering boot near the landing edge
near fan orientation toward that boot
gates.scope: agent-owned response geometry; acoustic sensing remains an inference

gates.expected: The human halted step is physically readable.
required_visible_components: other boot lifted a small distance
head and gaze oriented toward the near colony

gates.expected: The warm vulnerable human, cold living chamber and near organism orientation create a quiet sense of threat or unease.
gates.scope: agent-owned artistic judgment, recorded separately from technical fidelity
